notes.CHE: 全國從來沒有強制投票；19 世紀好幾個邦有，1974 年以後只剩沙夫豪森邦
notes.CHL: 2012 年取消強制投票，2022 年恢復（條目寫執行情況未定）
notes.BEL: 1894 年起強制投票，但 2003 年以後幾乎不再起訴
notes.AUS: 聯邦選舉 1924 年起強制投票，投票率約 92%
notes.SGP: 1959 年起強制投票；沒投票的人會從選舉人名冊除名，要有正當理由或繳 50 新幣才能恢復
notes.PRK: 17 歲以上都要投票，但每區只有一位執政黨或其聯盟提名的候選人
notes.BRA: 1932 年起強制投票，海外的巴西人也要投票
notes.ITA: 1945–1993 年強制投票（沒有正式罰則）
notes.BGR: 2016 年國會通過強制投票，隔年被憲法法院宣告無效
notes.CYP: 1960 年起強制投票，2017 年廢除
notes.VEN: 1993 年廢除（之前大多沒有執行）
notes.TWN: 台灣的選舉與公投都不強制投票

notesEn.CHE: Never compulsory nationally; several cantons once had it, but since 1974 only Schaffhausen
notesEn.CHL: Abolished in 2012 and reintroduced in 2022 (enforcement listed as to be determined)
notesEn.BEL: Compulsory since 1894, but offenders have almost never been prosecuted since 2003
notesEn.AUS: Compulsory for federal elections since 1924; turnout about 92%
notesEn.SGP: Enforced since 1959; non-voters are struck off the electoral roll until they give a valid reason or pay S$50
notesEn.PRK: Everyone over 17 must vote, but there is only one candidate per seat, from the ruling party or its allies
notesEn.BRA: Compulsory since 1932, including for Brazilians abroad
notesEn.ITA: Compulsory from 1945 to 1993 (with only informal sanctions)
notesEn.BGR: Introduced by parliament in 2016 and annulled by the Constitutional Court the following year
notesEn.TWN: Voting is not compulsory in Taiwan's elections or referendums
